configurePresets.name: bench-opt
configurePresets.description: Production-grade -O3 + NDEBUG used by every default build (postgresql_bioseq, the test execs, bioseq_benchmark). The previous form of this preset also carried `-save-temps=obj -g`; both were dropped because they more than doubled per-TU peak RSS on the heavy-template TUs (dispatch_buffer.cppm, two_stacks_minimizers.cppm) — the DWARF tables alone push the dispatch_buffer compile from ~5 GB to >11 GB and the .ii/.s/.bc dumps add a multi-GB write per TU on top of that. `CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG` is set to an empty string so `-g` is NOT silently re-added by the `Debug` build type (the Debug type is preserved only because other CMake logic in the tree branches on it). For the inspect MCP tool (which needs the per-TU .s/.bc and DWARF) use the `bench-opt-debug` preset, or pass `debug=true` to `start_build` so the MCP server selects that preset automatically.

configurePresets.name: bench-e2e-opt
configurePresets.description: Isolated production-flavor tree for benchmark-e2e. Only this tree compiles statement-scoped CIGAR/MAPQ interval evidence into the Bioseq DSO and module owners.

configurePresets.name: test-opt
configurePresets.description: Isolated bench-opt-equivalent tree with BIOSEQ_TEST_INDEXES enabled. Keeping test hooks/descriptors in build/test-opt prevents benchmark binaries in build/bench-opt from silently carrying failure-injection branches or test-only indexes.

configurePresets.name: highway-gcc-canary
configurePresets.description: Opt-in Darwin GCC boundary proof: an isolated empty-environment, no-vcpkg-toolchain Ninja sub-build compiles and links a conservative two-target Highway dispatch table, a compile/link-only attributed target probe, and the generic generated-module closure with authenticated Homebrew g++-16, then audits their sealed dyld dependencies. The local builder executes the imported-binder canary and records its selected target IDs only when build_only=false. This is not the full external-api or production DSO build.

configurePresets.name: bench-opt-debug
configurePresets.displayName: Benchmark-tuned optimisation config (with debug symbols and per-TU temps)
configurePresets.description: Same -O3 + NDEBUG as `bench-opt`, plus `-save-temps=obj` (keeps per-TU .s/.ii/.bc artifacts beside each .o so the inspect MCP tool can extract assembly and IR for any function) and `-g` (preserves DWARF symbols for source-line cross-references in objdump output). Lives under build/bench-opt-debug/ so it does not invalidate the default bench-opt ninja graph. ~2x slower to compile and ~2-3x peak RSS per TU than `bench-opt`; only use when the inspect tool is needed.

configurePresets.name: aws-x64-linux
configurePresets.displayName: AWS x86_64 Linux benchmark box (clang-22 + libc++)
configurePresets.description: Linux/x86_64 analogue of bench-opt for the disposable AWS reference machine provisioned by infra. Selects the AWS_MACHINE_X64 toolchain block in CMakeLists.txt via the environment and builds bioseq with clang-22 + libc++ (required for import std / C++ modules). vcpkg dependencies use the checked-in x64-linux-libcxx overlay triplet so C++ static archives link against the same libc++ ABI as bioseq. -O3 + NDEBUG, DWARF off, mirroring bench-opt.
